backend/main.mo: Defines a contact form submission actor that stores submissions in a map with incremental IDs and exposes methods to add, retrieve one, or retrieve all sorted submissions.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing implemented features, linked files, components, and test IDs for marketing copy updates and product flavor updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend file paths to short descriptive summaries of their purpose within the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme color tokens, base styles, and global utility variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta description and script loader for the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing navigation between homepage and submissions view and rendering all major site sections.
frontend/src/components/BrandBadge.tsx: Wrapper around the Badge component adding consistent brand styling and optional variants.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a pickle product with name, description, and spice level indicator using flame icons and color-coded badges.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper providing consistent section spacing and container width.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer showing brand info, inclusive tagline, contact details, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with logo, navigation links, mobile sheet menu, and internal submissions link handling smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor, updating it based on Internet Identity authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, including login, logout, and restoring saved identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting a contact form and fetching contact form submissions through an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and utility styles.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function for merging class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app by rendering React with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/sections/ContactSection.tsx: Implements a contact form section with validation, submission handling, and success/error UI states.
frontend/src/sections/FaqSection.tsx: Renders an FAQ section using an accordion component populated with preset questions and answers.
frontend/src/sections/HomeHeroSection.ts: Displays the hero section with branding, description, image, and buttons that scroll to other sections.
frontend/src/sections/OurStorySection.ts: Shows the brand story with descriptive text and highlighted feature icons.
frontend/src/sections/ProductsSection.ts: Lists predefined pickle products and shows a product image and product cards.
frontend/src/sections/ReviewsSection.tsx: Displays customer reviews in a grid of cards with avatars, ratings, and testimonial text.
frontend/src/views/SubmissionsView.tsx: React view that fetches and displays contact form submissions in a table with loading and error states.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining site goals, architectural notes, features, and metadata for a homemade pickle business website.
